commands: env ANTFLY_CATALOG_REPORT_BENCH=1 python3 tools/run_bounded_zig_build.py build antfly-system-catalog-report-bench
env ANTFLY_CATALOG_REPORT_BENCH=1 python3 tools/run_bounded_zig_build.py build antfly-system-catalog-progress-test

limitations: Both paths use the new implementation. The full-runtime comparison includes activity scanning; it is not a reconstruction or build of the old retained-runtime path.
Preparation only, excluding fixture creation, prepared-result destruction, HTTP, Raft, and storage apply. Each prepared result is abandoned so all samples compare against the same acknowledged base.
Synthetic inventory has 32 identical index descriptors per group. Wide-inventory behavior is measured; unique index-name lookup is not.

Former scan implementation retained as an equality oracle in the same Debug test artifact. Includes schema parsing, index construction, readiness checks, and result allocation; excludes result destruction and fixture creation.
In-process collection only. No DB collection, HTTP, Raft replication, or cutover latency. Request counts are calculated from the validated 64-record batch limit, not measured network counts.

validation.catalog_e2e: 7 passed in 61.44 seconds, including real document schema migration and 64-record HTTP batch validation/replay
validation.production_runtime: 2 production DataServer simulations and 11 worker/scheduler/snapshot tests passed; zero leaks
validation.core: Catalog storage, API and progress targets passed
